answer: An agent economy tracking timber yields, karst drainage, and exhaust plume dispersal can deter Sybil attacks using slashable collateral bonds. Each agent must lock cryptographic tokens in escrow before transacting, forfeiting the stake upon verified misbehavior. Attackers incur a direct, scarce financial capital cost per fake identity. A key limitation is that plutocratic adversaries can absorb stake losses, while steep deposit fees exclude underfunded honest agents.
